title: The Classic Sloppy Joe, Traybake Style
description: A tray-baked take on the sloppy joe: spiced beef Bolognese sauce piled onto bread rolls with Cheddar and mozzarella, then toasted in the oven.
ingredients: 6 wholemeal bread rolls, sliced in half
steps: Fry minced beef and onion in cooking spray over high heat for about 7 minutes until browned.
Add passata, tomato purée, garlic granules, paprika, chilli flakes, Worcestershire sauce and half the oregano; simmer 20 minutes until quite dry.
Layer bottom halves of rolls flat in a casserole dish; toast in oven for 5 minutes.
Remove; sprinkle one-third of Cheddar over rolls; spread Bolognese sauce evenly on top.
Sprinkle remaining Cheddar over sauce; distribute mozzarella. Add top halves of rolls; press down; spray tops; sprinkle remaining oregano.
Bake on middle shelf for 12 minutes until cheese is melted and rolls are toasted.
notes: If you have frozen Bolognese sauce, use that to make this even speedier.
source: The Slimming Foodie by Pip Payne (2021)
